decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API extends the firm's core messaging platform at low marginal cost and has been shown steadily on its own page since 2023, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The email-to-SMS gateway reuses the existing messaging infrastructure and fits the firm's integrated communication offer, and as a large firm with slack it can carry this recently launched product while results remain uncertain.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B within the same channel-integration logic and costs little to maintain, so dropping it after one year without evidence of shortfall would be premature.
